description: Cross-codec contract vectors (CF-6). Each vector carries a raw control-channel JSON line (wire) and the verdict expected on each side: csharp = MessageCodec.TryDecode result, kotlin = SimHubProtocol.parse result. A verdict mismatch between the two codecs breaks at least one of the two mirror suites. Locks the DIM-1 (status.nav lenient), DIM-2 (hostId 1-128 in beacon/welcome) and DIM-3 corrections. DIM-3 (PCM payload > 8192) is a binary datagram, not a control line, and is covered separately by audio-header.json invalid[] on both sides; no binary vector is added here. docs/protocol.md is the authority.

vectors.name: status-nav-wrong-type-maneuver
vectors.note: DIM-1 (§6.7.1): nav.maneuver is a number, nav is ignored, the status stays valid on both sides.

vectors.name: status-nav-missing-maneuver
vectors.note: DIM-1 (§6.7.1): nav without maneuver is dropped, the status stays valid on both sides.

vectors.name: status-nav-not-an-object
vectors.note: DIM-1 (§6.7.1): nav is not an object, no route guidance, the status stays valid on both sides.

vectors.name: status-nav-valid
vectors.note: Boundary: a complete valid nav is accepted on both sides.

vectors.name: welcome-hostId-empty
vectors.note: DIM-2: welcome hostId must be 1-128 chars; empty is rejected on both sides.

vectors.name: welcome-hostId-over-128
vectors.note: DIM-2: welcome hostId of 129 chars exceeds the 1-128 bound; rejected on both sides.

vectors.name: beacon-hostId-empty
vectors.note: DIM-2: beacon hostId must be 1-128 chars; empty is rejected on both sides.

vectors.name: beacon-hostId-over-128
vectors.note: DIM-2: beacon hostId of 129 chars exceeds the 1-128 bound; rejected on both sides.

vectors.name: welcome-hostId-128-ok
vectors.note: DIM-2 upper bound: welcome hostId of exactly 128 chars is accepted on both sides.

vectors.name: welcome-hostId-1-ok
vectors.note: DIM-2 lower bound: welcome hostId of 1 char is accepted on both sides.

vectors.name: hello-missing-tabletId
vectors.note: §6.1: required tabletId missing; rejected on both sides.

vectors.name: hello-protocol-zero
vectors.note: §7.1: protocol must be >= 1; rejected on both sides.

vectors.name: pairRequest-token-and-pin
vectors.note: §6.3: token and pin together is rejected on both sides.

vectors.name: pairResult-ok-without-token
vectors.note: §6.4: ok:true requires a token; rejected on both sides.

vectors.name: state-missing-audio
vectors.note: §6.6: required audio missing; rejected on both sides.

vectors.name: status-unknown-screen
vectors.note: §6.7: screen value projector is not defined; rejected on both sides.

vectors.name: command-unknown-action
vectors.note: §6.8: action value shuffle is not defined; rejected on both sides.

vectors.name: type-unknown
vectors.note: §14.2: unknown message type; rejected on both sides (UnknownType / Unknown).

vectors.name: heartbeat-seq-negative
vectors.note: Boundary: heartbeat seq below 0 is out of range; rejected on both sides.

vectors.name: heartbeat-valid
vectors.note: Boundary: a minimal valid heartbeat is accepted on both sides.
